name: book-to-course
description: Turn a book or document (EPUB, PDF, HTML, DOCX, Markdown, TXT) into an interactive, beginner-friendly course delivered as a local web page — with lessons, animations, quizzes, chapter tests, flashcards and programming exercises checked by unit tests. Includes course-to-apk to package a course as an offline Android app (APK) and course-to-appimage to package it as a Linux desktop app (AppImage).
